input.title: Retain authored upgrade loading slots and preview lifetime
input.body:
## Summary

```text
three authored slots → receive default → initialize preview/listeners
missing default       → keep loading
child visit/return    → retain cards, canvases, fits and art age
```

Preserves UpgradeMenu loading independently of motion: cached/live class inputs, null-result counters, ordered recenter/removal behavior, root frames1–4 and the imported five-dot loader. Creator return reuses initialized offers without preference rerolls. Selection removes card handlers while bottom input remains live.

Layer1 of the next five-PR batch. Assemble all layers in the last PR and validate its combined head before one master merge. Batch branches use `stack/**` to suppress automatic previews.

## Evidence

- **Before:** compressed available offers appeared ready immediately; child visits recreated previews and rerolled offers.
  **After:** stable slots and pending loading survive, with retained preview paint source/canvas/fit/age.
- Formatting, TypeScript, 903 unit tests / 8,342 assertions and production builds passed.
- Literal `bun run test:e2e`: all8 mock/supplied-SWF cases passed, zero skips/flaky cases, across upgrade-loading, upgrade-presentation, upgrade-defaults and edit-flow. Paint inspected in both modes; checks include Chromium accessibility, pending-menu keyboard activation, renderer identity, reversal and teardown.
- Import regenerates byte-identically; old ready-menu geometry/widgets remain unchanged. No media/dependency/build output committed.
- Unsaved automatic return has source/service coverage without a direct browser case. Lazy preview readiness is an explicit browser adapter; constructor/RNG/frame scheduling, Adobe and full-game parity remain unproved.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** upgrade

Changes loading/input and retained child-view lifetime. Require current-head Actions and actionable-review gates; hold master integration for the five-layer batch. Vercel quota failures are waived; no deployment retries/account changes.
